choices.content: All slow learners attend this school.
All slow learners do not attend this school.
Some slow learners attend this school.
Some slow learners do not attend this school.
No slow learners do not attend this school.

question.prompt: The negation of the statement “No slow learners attend this school,” is:

solutions.explanation:
The statement “No slow learners attend this school” says that there is no person who is both a slow learner and an attendee of the school. It is false exactly when at least one person has both properties.

Here “some” means at least one. Therefore the negation is “Some slow learners attend this school,” choice C.
solutions.title: Replace none with at least one
